questions.prompt: What makes a blocking file read main-safe?
questions.answer: withContext on an injected IO dispatcher
questions.explanation: The blocking operation is moved from Main while its owner keeps the API contract simple.

questions.prompt: Every suspend function automatically runs on Dispatchers.IO.
questions.explanation: Suspend functions inherit coroutine context unless implementation changes it.

questions.prompt: Which builder represents a value that will be awaited?
questions.explanation: async returns Deferred and is appropriate when concurrent work produces a value.

questions.prompt: A well-structured suspend function should usually launch hidden GlobalScope work.
questions.explanation: The caller should retain completion, cancellation, and failure control.

questions.prompt: What should a broad catch do with CancellationException?
questions.explanation: Cancellation is a structured control signal and must reach the parent.

questions.prompt: Adding suspend to a CPU loop makes it cancellation-cooperative.
questions.explanation: The loop must encounter a suspending call or explicit cancellation check.
Supervision preserves siblings only when their outcomes remain valuable independently.

questions.prompt: SupervisorJob automatically handles and logs every child exception.
questions.explanation: It changes cancellation propagation; errors still require explicit handling.
